defmodule PaymentGateway.Config do
  @moduledoc "Payment gateway configuration with environment-aware encoding"

  def get_encoding_mode do
    case System.get_env("PAYMENT_ENCODING_MODE") do
      "strict" -> :strict
      "compat" -> :compat
      _ -> :standard
    end
  end

  def max_amount_cents do
    case System.get_env("MIX_ENV") do
      "prod" -> 999_999_99
      _ -> 999_999_999_99
    end
  end

  def currency_precision("JPY"), do: 0
  def currency_precision("BHD"), do: 3
  def currency_precision(_), do: 2
end

defmodule PaymentGateway.AmountEncoder do
  @moduledoc "Encodes payment amounts for wire protocol transmission"

  alias PaymentGateway.Config

  @doc "Encode amount string to internal integer representation"
  def encode_amount(amount_str, currency) when is_binary(amount_str) do
    precision = Config.currency_precision(currency)
    encoding_mode = Config.get_encoding_mode()

    with {:ok, normalized} <- normalize_input(amount_str, encoding_mode),
         {:ok, parsed} <- parse_decimal(normalized, precision),
         {:ok, cents} <- to_minor_units(parsed, precision, encoding_mode) do
      validate_bounds(cents, currency)
    end
  end

  defp normalize_input(input, :strict) do
    if String.match?(input, ~r/^[0-9.,-]+$/) do
      {:ok, input}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_characters}
    end
  end

  defp normalize_input(input, :compat) do
    cleaned = input
    |> String.replace(~r/[\x{200B}\x{00A0}\x{FEFF}]/, "")
    |> String.replace(~r/\s+/, "")
    {:ok, cleaned}
  end

  defp normalize_input(input, :standard) do
    cleaned = input
    |> String.trim()
    |> String.replace(~r/[^0-9.\-]/, "")
    {:ok, cleaned}
  end

  defp parse_decimal(str, _precision) do
    case String.split(str, ".") do
      [whole] -> {:ok, {parse_int(whole), 0, 0}}
      [whole, frac] -> {:ok, {parse_int(whole), parse_int(frac), String.length(frac)}}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_format}
    end
  end

  defp parse_int(""), do: 0
  defp parse_int("-"), do: 0
  defp parse_int(s) do
    case Integer.parse(s) do
      {n, ""} -> n
      {n, _rest} -> n
      :error -> 0
    end
  end

  defp to_minor_units({whole, frac, frac_len}, precision, encoding_mode) do
    multiplier = :math.pow(10, precision) |> round()

    cents = case encoding_mode do
      :compat ->
        # In compat mode, handle variable-length fractional parts
        # by scaling the fractional component
        frac_scaled = if frac_len <= precision do
          frac * :math.pow(10, precision - frac_len) |> round()
        else
          frac |> div(round(:math.pow(10, frac_len - precision)))
        end
        whole * multiplier + frac_scaled

      _ ->
        # Standard: truncate to precision
        frac_scaled = if frac_len <= precision do
          frac * round(:math.pow(10, precision - frac_len))
        else
          div(frac, round(:math.pow(10, frac_len - precision)))
        end
        whole * multiplier + frac_scaled
    end

    {:ok, cents}
  end

  defp validate_bounds(cents, _currency) when cents < 0 do
    {:error, :negative_amount}
  end

  defp validate_bounds(cents, _currency) do
    max = Config.max_amount_cents()
    if cents <= max do
      {:ok, cents}
    else
      {:error, :exceeds_maximum}
    end
  end
end

defmodule PaymentGateway.Processor do
  @moduledoc "Main payment processing module"

  alias PaymentGateway.AmountEncoder

  def process_payment(params) do
    with {:ok, amount} <- validate_amount(params["amount"], params["currency"]),
         {:ok, _ref} <- submit_to_acquirer(amount, params) do
      {:ok, %{status: :approved, amount_cents: amount}}
    end
  end

  defp validate_amount(nil, _), do: {:error, :missing_amount}
  defp validate_amount(_, nil), do: {:error, :missing_currency}
  defp validate_amount(amount_str, currency) do
    AmountEncoder.encode_amount(amount_str, String.upcase(currency))
  end

  defp submit_to_acquirer(amount_cents, params) do
    # Wire protocol submission - amount_cents is trusted at this point
    payload = %{
      amount: amount_cents,
      currency: params["currency"],
      card_token: params["card_token"],
      merchant_id: params["merchant_id"]
    }
    # Simulated acquirer call
    {:ok, Base.encode16(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16))}
  end
end
